page.notes: The text "Neque obstat.2." keeps the printed superscript 2 as it appears in the line. The line-end hyphenations (ca-sus, fortui-to, mer-cede, ad-dixerit) are kept as printed. The "ad-" before "certum" is hard to confirm at the line end and may be unhyphenated in print. Long s is rendered as s throughout; the printed "f" forms (e.g. "fuum", "eft", "permiffum") are transcribed as suum, est, permissum.
